summary: Iteration 29: Comprehensive testing of ReelsPage, Explore cards in profile, chat profile navigation, mascot integration, and nav bar on camera. All 14 backend API tests passed. All frontend features verified working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 29 verified all new features: ReelsPage with TikTok-style UI (tabs: Reels, En Vivo), /lives and /reels routes both render ReelsPage, MyProfilePage Explorar tab shows public cards with 'Ver perfil del autor' links, chat profile navigation works via e.stopPropagation, BRUNO IA uses /mascots/bruno-logo.png, WelcomeTour uses mascot images, bottom nav is visible on camera page.

reels_page.details: ReelsPage at /reels loads with TikTok-style dark UI, two tabs (Reels, En Vivo), empty state shows 'No hay reels' with 'Crear Reel' button

lives_route_unified.details: /lives route renders the same ReelsPage component (unified routes)

reels_empty_state.details: Empty state shows 'No hay reels' with Film icon and 'Crear Reel' button

en_vivo_tab.details: En Vivo tab shows live streams grid or 'No hay transmisiones' empty state

my_profile_explorar_tab.details: MyProfilePage has 'Explorar' tab (Globe icon) showing public cards from /api/cards/explore with card type badge, avatar, title, and 'Ver perfil del autor' link

explore_cards_api.details: GET /api/cards/explore returns public cards correctly (new endpoint)

chat_name_profile_navigation.details: ChatList name click navigates to /profile/{userId} using e.stopPropagation to prevent chat opening

chat_header_profile_link.details: ChatView header avatar/name click navigates to profile

chat_read_receipt_dog_mascot.details: Read receipt shows /mascots/bruno-dog.webp instead of blue checkmarks

bruno_ia_floating_bubble.details: BRUNO IA floating bubble uses /mascots/bruno-logo.png as icon

welcome_tour_mascots.details: WelcomeTour steps include mascot images - alternating bruno-dog.webp and bruno-human.png

bottom_nav_on_camera.details: Bottom nav is VISIBLE on camera page (/camera removed from hiddenPaths)

bottom_nav_order.details: Bottom nav order: Inicio > Tienda > Reels > Camera (create) > Mapa > Alertas > Perfil (7 items)

test_classes: TestExploreCardsAPI - 5 tests (endpoint, returns list, structure, only public, limit param)
TestReelsPageAPIs - 3 tests (posts with media filter, lives endpoint, posts have user info)
TestAuthForChat - 3 tests (login returns token, chats requires auth, chat with auth)
TestPublicCards - 2 tests (public cards endpoint, single card)
